
### Serenity Mathews

![](../../pictures/SerenityMathews.jpg){.person-photo alt="Portrait of Serenity Mathews" fig-alt="Portrait of Serenity Mathews"}

**Research Technologist | Laboratory Manager**

**Office:** Buckhout 109  
**Email:** [smm8459@psu.edu](mailto:smm8459@psu.edu)

Serenity is a research technologist and laboratory manager in Penn State's Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology, working with Dr. Ricardo Alcalá-Briseño and Dr. David Beyer.

Her research focuses on fungal virology, particularly La France disease in the white button mushroom (*Agaricus bisporus*). She uses molecular diagnostic approaches to detect La France virus in samples collected from commercial mushroom farms, supporting industry-oriented disease monitoring.

She also contributes to mushroom cultivation and research operations at Penn State's Mushroom Research Center, supporting collaborative projects involving Plant Pathology, Entomology, and Engineering.

**Education:** B.S. in Biology, Pennsylvania State University.
